text:
alex: heads up — I just hit a weird one in the console quota panel. after a rapid org switch the timeseries briefly shows the previous org's usage lines
maria: ugh, repro steps? screenshot?
alex: quick repro: open org-A -> open Usage dashboard -> quick switch to org-B via header. sometimes the chart still renders A's lines for ~20-40s :eyes:
alex: looks like prefetch cache returns stale payload that isn't validated against current org header
maria: could be header-normalizer or the prefetch layer ignoring org-binding metadata
sre-jen: last week we saw affinity cookies cause stale session headers at the RL router. possible the edge is returning a cached API response missing X-Org-ID enforcement
product-ryan: any customer impact yet?
alex: small sample in prod canary (2/1000 rapid switches). saw twice in staging during manual smoke tests
maria: mitigation idea: guard in UI — when you apply prefetched data, verify payload.org_id === currentOrg, otherwise drop and refetch
sre-jen: that's the fastest stopgap. longer term we should enforce org-scoped caching at the router or cache key level (include org-id in key)
alex: agreed. I'll open a small PR for the UI guard so we can push in the next patch release
alex: snippet I'll add to PR: ```if (cached.result.org_id !== activeOrgId) { discard(cached); fetchFresh(); }```
maria: also add telemetry tag on the cached payload so we can query occurrences: `cache_source:prefetch, payload_org, viewed_org`
product-ryan: please surface this in release notes as "console quota visualization fix" if it reaches prod — ops might get questions
sre-jen: logging addition: include request_id + header_org in the quota backend metrics. without header_org it's hard to trace origin of lines
alex: created PR draft and linked a staging repro video in the PR comments. dev-bot: build queued
dev-bot: build #3421 started (alex/console-prefetch-org-guard)
maria: also let's add an alert: if chart shows >5% of datapoints where payload_org != viewing_org in a 5m window, fire an alert to eng-platform
alex: adding that to the ticket INF-1098 (includes repro, telemetry queries and suggested alert)
sre-jen: longer term: we should do an audit of all internal console APIs to ensure every cache/edge respects org header in key and in response meta
maria: filing a followup RFC for cache key hygiene and router affinity handling. preliminary owner: storage-team + eng-platform
product-ryan: good. keep me in the loop so PM can triage priority
alex: will do. For now UI guard + telemetry + alert gets us fast mitigation
notes: No title per agents spec. Thread captures root message and replies in chronological order. Contains code snippet and bot messages.
